note: Golden wire fixture (design spec decision 8). Each case records the exact
JSON a Presence sender puts on the wire, the exact top-level key ORDER (so
the recorded `json` is byte-reproducible from the parsed value), and the
nested key sets. The `data` payloads are short stand-ins — this fixture
pins the envelope, not decodable media.
The package test reads only this file. The cross-tree check — whether
Presence's own copies still carry these field names — is the monorepo's
scripts/check-signals-media-drift.mjs, which is dropped on extraction.

voiceFrameV1.description: Per-frame voice payload (the shape every released build parses), carrying a RED block of the two preceding frames.

voiceBatchV2.description: Batched voice payload — `packVoiceFrames` output: VOICE_BATCH_FRAMES frames under a { v: 2, frames } envelope. The RED block rides the batch's first frame only.

filmstripClip.description: A filmstrip clip as sent. `kind` is omitted by the sender (clip is the default); a receiver also accepts an explicit 'clip'.

filmstripStop.description: The explicit stop payload sent when the sender turns video off, so the receiver clears its display without waiting for the inactivity TTL.
